newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Sept automobile sales up 14.6 pct-Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Thai Sept automobile sales up 14.6 pct-Toyota.

text.p: Sales in Thailand of cars and commercial vehicles in September rose 14.6 percent to 52,092 units from 45,468 in the same month last year, Toyota Motors (Thailand) said on Monday.
The rise in vehicle sales in September was due to promotion campaigns by most car makers during the month, Toyota said in a statement.
Cumulative vehicles sales in the first nine months were up 5.2 percent to 435,021 units from 413,684 in the same period last year, it said.
Toyota remained the biggest seller of vehicles in the month with a 27.5 percent market share, or 14,323 units, against 12,019 in the same month last year, Toyota said.
Isuzu car was second with 9,931 units in September accounting for 19.1 percent market share, against 10,241 last year, it said.
Total passengers car sales in September jumped 24.4 percent to 15,543 units from 12,494 in the same month a year ago.
Toyota topped passenger car sales with 4,280 units, or a 27.5 percent market share compared with 3,805.
Honda cars came second with 3,869 cars sold in the month, or 24.9 percent of the market, compared with 1,148 in the same month last year, it said.
